node.title: Rate-half MCA K-to-K+1 badness transport counterexample
node.statement: On one explicit deployed KoalaBear record, the received pair (u,v)=(1_E,X^k), slope 0, and an exact size-m support S give a support-wise MCA-bad witness for RS[F,D,k], while the identical slope and support are pair-contained for RS[F,D,k+1] because X^k enters the enlarged code. Thus silent K=k+1 prefix-envelope transport does not preserve actual degree-<k witness badness or first-owner semantics. Any repaired SEM-QBC or whole-line-selector adapter must retain and recheck the original degree and pair-noncontainment guards. A guarded adapter remains open.
